fields.System.Title: INV-701 — Adjust stock with a reason code
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to correct a stock figure with a recorded reason, so
that the system matches reality and we know why it did not.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a location, product, and batch, when I set the correct quantity, then the
  • balance changes by the difference.
  • - Given an adjustment, then a reason code from the controlled list is mandatory.
  • - Given an upward adjustment, then a movement from VIRT-GAIN is written.
  • - Given a downward adjustment, then a movement to VIRT-LOSS is written.
  • - Given the same adjustment request sent twice with the same idempotency key, then the
  • balance changes once.
  • - Given the adjustment, then the adjustment record captures who requested it and when.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement, adjustment |
| Risks | Adjustment without a movement ([doc 09 §2.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); posted twice ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · invariant |
